thread:
Anya: Quick heads-up — PR #432 changes /v2/generate structured output. In some edge cases we currently return "results": null. Need a quick call: should the API return null, an empty array, or omit the key?

Mike: Which client is tripping on null? Link to the PR?

Anya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/432 — basic diff is here. Example of current behavior in failing case:
```http
POST /v2/generate
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "..."
}
```
Response we saw from older model node: 
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "results": null,
  "metadata": null
}
```

Jess: Clients tend to explode on results===null when they expect an array. Returning [] is safer for arrays. For optional object fields (like metadata) we usually prefer omitting the key if empty, rather than null. :thumbsup:

Sam: Quick summary from client-compat perspective:
- If the field is an array (results) -> return [] instead of null.
- If the field is an object (metadata) -> prefer omit.
- If it's a scalar we probably shouldn't return null unless documented.
Agree?

Lina: +1. Also propose we add a small JSON Schema and a linter rule so future PRs get flagged. Proposed schema snippet:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "results": { "type": "array" },
    "metadata": { "type": ["object"], "nullable": false }
  },
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```
Note: using "nullable": false to be explicit that metadata shouldn't be null; we enforce omission when empty.

Anya: That sounds good. I'll update the PR to convert null -> [] for results and remove metadata when empty. I'll also add a note in the API contract (docs) and open a linter rule issue. cc @platform-test for canary.

platform-test: On it — I'll add an E2E that asserts results is always an array and metadata is absent when empty. Scheduling canary run after PR update.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued for PR 432 — run id: canary-2024-11-07-09-12 (ETA ~15m) :robot_face:

Anya: Thanks all. I'll push the update (convert nulls) in the next hour and ping here when CI is green.

Mike: Quick ask — can we also add a short note in SDK changelog so devs know why behavior changed? Some integrations rely on null.

Anya: Yep — adding changelog + migration note.

Jess: Perfect, thanks. :raised_hands:

Sam: If anyone wants to join to review the linter rule, ping me.

Anya: Will do. Closing this thread for now — will update when PR merged.
